R1.description: A repository can declare a backlog file and an optional generator in WORKFLOW_CONFIG.json; a malformed or missing declared file fails closed with a code and one next step, never a fall-back to prose; no declaration means today's behaviour

R2.description: The file format is a strict documented YAML subset with its own parser, a schema (types, statuses, unique id and order, known depends_on, no cycles) and exact accepted and refused forms

R3.description: /milestone-plan with no argument takes the next item by the stated selection rule and refuses with a clear message when none is ready; without a declaration it is unchanged

R4.description: Acceptance sets the item done, optionally records a release, regenerates the page by the declared generator or the built-in one, never hand-edits the page, lands in the acceptance commit, and is unchanged without a declaration

R5.description: A built-in generator and a check mode, with the stated precedence of a declared generator

R6.description: The shipped backlog document and the user documents, the command texts and the tests for every new path, including the unchanged behaviour without a declaration

R7.description: Release 2.17.0: manifest and manager block, release constant and its assertions, release history, the downgrade posture
